caption: The problem: the core table view gives one row per note, so a list of milestones is one cell.
Flatten table: one row for each milestone of each project, with the milestone keys as columns and a link to the note.
Click a column header to sort. Numbers sort as numbers and ISO dates in date order.

caption: Sort by owner first, then by due date. The header numbers show priority.
eval: (async () => { app.plugins.plugins['flatten-table'].pro.signOut(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); const view = app.plugins.plugins['flatten-table'].targetView(); view.config.set('flattenSort', null); view.render(); const header = name => [...document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .flatten-table th')].find(x => x.querySelector('button > span').textContent === name); header('owner').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); header('due').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { shiftKey: true, bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); if (view.last.rows.length !== 43 || view.options().sort.length !== 2) throw new Error('Multi-column sort failed'); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { const view = app.plugins.plugins['flatten-table'].targetView(); view.config.set('flattenSort', null); view.render(); return 'ok'; })()
